recipes.name: Text Hub
actions: Show a menu: Build Prompt, Transform Text, Text Library, Build Reply, Copy Date, Make Link, Expand Anywhere
Run the selected child Shortcut
Pass Shortcut Input through when available
recipes.terminal_safety: Delegates to the selected child. Does not paste.
validation_steps: Run Text Hub
Each menu item opens the matching child Shortcut
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a Shortcut named Text Hub for iPhone, iPad, and Mac. Show a menu with Build Prompt, Transform Text, Text Library, Build Reply, Copy Date, Make Link, and Expand Anywhere. Run the selected Shortcut and pass Shortcut Input into it when available. Do not paste into other apps. Do not include private addresses or secrets.

recipes.name: Build Prompt
actions: Resolve input from Shortcut Input, then selected text, then clipboard, then Ask for Input
Ask for Objective, Rigor, Execution model, Deliverable, and optional requirements
Render delimited plain text
Copy to clipboard and return as output
recipes.terminal_safety: Copies text only. Never pastes into a terminal.
validation_steps: Provide sample input
Confirm the rendered prompt contains the source material in a delimited block
Confirm the clipboard matches the output
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a Shortcut named Build Prompt. Resolve text input in this order: Shortcut Input, selected text if available, clipboard, then Ask for Input. Ask the user to choose an Objective from Research, Audit and improve, Continue and finish, Plan and specify, Implement, Debug, Compare alternatives, Analyze a business model, Map competitors, Generate names. Ask for Rigor from Focused, Thorough, Deep, Maximum depth. Ask for Execution model from Single agent, Parallel subagents, Massively parallel agent team. Ask for Deliverable from Direct answer, Markdown guide, Implementation plan, Specification bundle, Task graph, Production code and tests, HTML guide, Research report. Offer optional requirements: Use current web research, Prefer primary sources, Source existing solutions first, Include citations, Verify every requirement, Return the complete artifact. Render structured plain text with clearly delimited input material. Copy the result to the clipboard and return it as Shortcut output. Do not call an external AI API.

recipes.name: Transform Text
actions: Resolve input
Ask for a transform
For list transforms, split by newlines and repeat
Copy and return the result
recipes.terminal_safety: Copies text only. Never pastes into a terminal.
validation_steps: Transform a multiline list into bullets
Confirm source lines are preserved except for the chosen prefix
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a Shortcut named Transform Text. Resolve input from Shortcut Input, selected text if available, clipboard, then Ask for Input. Ask the user to choose one transform: Markdown quote, Bullet list, Checklist, Numbered list, Six-backtick code block, Normalize whitespace, Trim surrounding whitespace, Lowercase, Uppercase, Title case, URL-safe slug, Wrap as AI review material, Wrap as source material. For list transforms, split the text by newlines and repeat the transform on each item. Preserve source text exactly unless the selected transform explicitly changes it. Copy the result to the clipboard and return it. Expose this Shortcut to the Share Sheet when possible.

recipes.name: Text Library
actions: Read the generated non-private registry JSON from iCloud Drive Shortcuts/AgentsText/registry.json
Allow search by key or label and browse by category
Copy the selected text and return it
recipes.terminal_safety: Copies non-private registry text only. Never pastes into a terminal.
validation_steps: Open Text Library
Select AI • Deep research
Confirm the clipboard contains composed public fragments only
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a Shortcut named Text Library. Get the File from iCloud Drive at Shortcuts/AgentsText/registry.json and parse it as JSON. Let the user search by key or label or browse by category. Include composed entries from the JSON such as AI • Deep research, AI • Audit and improve, AI • Continue and finish, AI • Planning and task graph, Build • Codex kickoff, Engineering • Python defaults, and Engineering • Frontend defaults. Copy the selected text to the clipboard and return it as output. Do not read Apple Text Replacement internals. Do not include private address values.

recipes.name: Build Reply
actions: Ask for recipient, medium, tone, topic, main message, next step, optional deadline, and sign-off
Render deterministic reply text
Copy and return the result
recipes.terminal_safety: Copies text only. Never pastes into a terminal.
validation_steps: Choose Email and Professional
Confirm the result is deterministic and contains the provided topic
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a Shortcut named Build Reply. Ask for Recipient, Medium, Tone, Topic, Main message, Requested next step, Deadline if any, and Sign-off. Medium choices: Email, Text message, Slack or Teams, GitHub, LinkedIn. Tone choices: Brief, Friendly, Professional, Formal, Direct. Render deterministic reply text from those answers. Do not call an external AI service. Copy the result to the clipboard and return it.

recipes.name: Copy Date
actions: Ask for a date format
Format the current date
Copy and return the value
recipes.terminal_safety: Copies a one-line date string. Does not paste.
validation_steps: Choose ISO date
Confirm yyyy-MM-dd output
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a Shortcut named Copy Date. Ask the user to choose one format: ISO date as yyyy-MM-dd, ISO local timestamp as yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ssZZZZZ, Filename timestamp as yyyyMMdd-HHmmss, Human date as MMMM d, yyyy, Human date and time as MMMM d, yyyy 'at' h:mm a, Markdown date heading as ## yyyy-MM-dd. Format the current date with that format. Copy the result to the clipboard and return it.

recipes.name: Make Link
actions: Resolve a URL from Shortcut Input, Share Sheet, clipboard, or Ask for Input
Ask for a title
Ask for Markdown, HTML, or plain labeled URL
Copy and return the formatted link
recipes.terminal_safety: Copies a one-line link. Does not paste into a terminal.
validation_steps: Share a URL from Safari
Confirm Markdown output uses the provided title
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a Shortcut named Make Link. Resolve the URL from Shortcut Input, the Share Sheet, the clipboard, or Ask for Input. Ask for a title. Ask the user to choose Markdown, HTML, or Plain labeled URL. Output exactly [title](url), or an HTML anchor, or title: url. Copy the result and return it. Show this Shortcut in Safari and browser Share Sheets when possible.

recipes.name: Expand Anywhere
actions: Capture the frontmost application
Ask for a trigger or choose from the non-private registry
Copy using Local Only when available
Auto-paste only after Accessibility approval and only when shell-safe in terminals
Never send Return
Restore the previous clipboard after a short delay when practical
recipes.terminal_safety: Auto-paste only one-line shell_safe entries into Ghostty or Terminal. Copy-only for multiline, AI, and message bodies. Never send Return.
validation_steps: In TextEdit, expand mygh
In Ghostty, expand mygh without pressing Return
In Ghostty, choose aiplan and confirm copy-only
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a Mac-only Shortcut named Expand Anywhere. This is an explicit hotkey fallback, not typed automatic expansion. Capture the frontmost application before showing UI. Ask for a trigger or let the user choose from the non-private iCloud registry at Shortcuts/AgentsText/registry.json. Resolve the matching enabled non-private entry. If the destination is Ghostty or Terminal, auto-paste only when the entry is one line and marked shell safe in the registry. Otherwise copy the text, show a notification, and do not paste. Never append Return or a newline. Copy using Local Only if available. Restore the original application. Restore the previous clipboard after a short delay when practical. Never execute pasted text. Do not include private address values.

recipes.name: Agents Text Bridge
inputs: JSON dictionary with schema, action, and key
actions: Parse Shortcut Input as JSON
Validate schema and action
Dispatch lookup, compose, transform, date, or link without prompts when the payload is complete
Return rendered text and copy when requested
outputs: Rendered text or an actionable error
recipes.terminal_safety: Noninteractive. Returns text only. Never pastes into a terminal.
validation_steps: Run shortcuts run 'Agents Text Bridge' with a lookup JSON payload
Confirm invalid JSON returns an actionable error
recipes.describe_prompt: Create a noninteractive Shortcut named Agents Text Bridge suitable for shortcuts run. Receive Shortcut Input as text containing JSON. Parse it as a dictionary. Require schema equal to 1 and an action of lookup, compose, transform, date, or link. For lookup, resolve key against the non-private iCloud registry. Avoid Ask for Input when the payload is complete. Return the rendered text. Copy it only when the payload requests copying. Produce an actionable error for invalid input. Do not include private values. Do not fabricate unofficial Shortcut binaries.
